clues.text: During a drought, ravens brought this prophet bread and meat each morning and evening by the Brook of Cherith.
On Mount Carmel, the fire of the LORD fell and burned up this prophet's water-soaked offering before the prophets of Baal.
A chariot of fire with horses of fire appeared, and this prophet went up into heaven in a whirlwind.
At Zarephath, a widow's jar of flour and jug of oil never ran out because of this prophet's word.
On a high mountain, he and Moses appeared talking with Jesus while Peter, James, and John watched.
Running from Jezebel, this prophet sat under a broom tree in the wilderness and prayed that he might die.
At Horeb, after a wind, an earthquake, and a fire, this prophet heard a still, small voice.
